# Mission 1

## Trial Synthesis

The first and third trial matched my expectations. But the second trial has the largest heading difference and the third trial had the largest positional difference. A possible cause is the odometry calculation being off so the numbers is less than expected and the other issues going on in the robot where it moves and rotates less than expected.

## Hallway Analysis

When the robot changes direction when it is near a person. A person might expect the robot to continue to move forward when they are nearby and so the person will move out of the robots way and then if the robot also turns to move they might crash into each other. Can make it so that the robot has some kind of distance when they are moving around people. The trade off is that it will not work properly in very crowded areas. For example have 1 meter between the robot and an object. Can evaluate if the robot is keeping this distance by using LiDAR and testing it in an environment.
